question: Berkeley algorithmic-rent ban (BMC ch. 13.63, Ord. 7992): two published effective dates.

positions.claim: 1 March 2026 (ordinance text, per the organisers' brief)

our_answer.key_value: Ban on sale or use of coordinated pricing algorithms (using nonpublic competitor data under 90 days old) for setting rents or occupancy levels
our_answer.conflict_note: Open question: two published effective dates exist for this ban (1 March 2026 in the ordinance text per the brief; January 2026 per an August 2026 law-firm alert). Neither effective date is stated in this capture.

how_we_handle_it: We record the date stated in a corpus document (January 2026 from the law-firm alert, month precision) and set conflict_flag with a note naming both dates; the rule is in force on the default query date either way.

question: New Jersey FAIR Act (P.L. 2026, c.43) may pre-empt the Jersey City (§ 218-12) and Hoboken (ch. 158) algorithmic-rent ordinances once effective on 2027-07-01.

positions.claim: FAIR Act § 6(b): municipalities may not enact conflicting ordinances
Local bans adopted 2025 remain on the books

sources.url: https://ecode360.com/HO0741 (Hoboken Code ch. 158, PDF download dated 2026-10-03)

our_answer.key_value: Ban on algorithmic rent-setting coordination (use of coordinators / algorithmic devices performing a coordinating function)
our_answer.conflict_note: Possible preemption of the Jersey City and Hoboken algorithmic-rent ordinances: section 6(b) bars municipal ordinances that conflict with the act. This document does not name those ordinances or resolve whether they conflict.

how_we_handle_it: The engine flags every Jersey City and Hoboken algorithmic-ban row and the FAIR Act row with conflict_flag and 'Possible preemption by the NJ FAIR Act from 2027-07-01 — flagged for human review'. We do not decide preemption.

question: Los Angeles RSO new allowable-increase formula: two published effective dates.

our_answer.key_value: Once per 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage (percentage is in a linked PDF, not in this text); no utilities add-on since 2026-02-02
our_answer.conflict_note: Open question: the new RSO formula has two published effective dates, 2026-02-02 per LAHD and 2026-01-24 per a landlord association. This LAHD page gives February 2, 2026; the landlord-association date is not found in this capture.

how_we_handle_it: We use the LAHD date (official agency page) as effective_date and set conflict_flag with a note recording the landlord-association date.

question: California application screening-fee cap (Civ. Code § 1950.6): no single official 2026 dollar figure.

positions.claim: Statute: $30 base adjusted annually by CPI since 1998; the current figure is not stated

our_answer.key_value: $30 per applicant, adjustable annually for CPI increases beginning January 1, 1998

how_we_handle_it: key_value stays the statutory formula ($30 adjusted by CPI) rather than a dollar figure; the statute states no 2026 amount.
